The '''techno-priests''' was a group located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kaliska]] that developed the esoteric technology of the [[visualization engine]], a machine that could predict future events based on user input. The techno-priests maintained the engine on Kaliska during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="TVE">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Investigation|"The Visualization Engine"}}</ref>
